channel.title: Maple's Weekly Menu
channel.description: A weekly menu of recipe picks, curated for the Mela recipe app.

item.title: Spicy Soy-Glazed Chicken with Broccoli & Scallion Butter Rice (Blue Apron)
item.description: Sambal oelek lends its vibrant heat to an umami-rich mix of soy glaze and rice vinegar, which deliciously coats pan-seared chicken, plus an aromatic bed of rice dressed with butter and savory soy sauce. (Blue Apron, from the Sep 14 delivery)

item.title: Seared Scallops & Truffle Risotto with Mushrooms, Spinach & Crispy Onions (Blue Apron)
item.description: Rich flavors abound in this decadent dish thanks to a mushroom and truffle risotto topped with delicate seared scallops and crispy onions. (Blue Apron, from the Sep 14 delivery)

item.title: Korean-Style Cheesy Pork & Rice Cakes with Mushrooms & Kimchi (Blue Apron)
item.description: Chewy Korean rice cakes simmered with an umami-rich, saucy blend of pork, mushrooms, and miso-kicked bechamel, finished with kimchi and melty cheese. Add gochujang for a little or a lot of spice. (Blue Apron, from the Sep 14 delivery)
